subject: Credential rotation ledger + SAML assertion provenance for CAIQ/SIG intake
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <security@healthcore.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <procurement@healthcore.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Apr 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ/SIG intake — need rotation ledger + assertion provenance

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking our intake. As we prepare HealthCore's CAIQ/SIG submission, our security team needs artifacts that prove custody and rotation of long-lived credentials (service keys and service accounts), plus a small set of SAML assertion samples tied to those accounts for our assertion-timing checks. Specifically, could you provide: 

- Rotation ledger covering 2024–2025 for service credentials (who rotated, timestamp, reason).
- Representative SAML assertion samples with timestamps and the associated subject/principal (to validate assertion audience/expiry).
- SCIM delta export covering Oct–Dec 2024 showing role changes for accounts used by machine identities.

If possible, include any redaction guidance (we will redact PII) and an expected delivery window. We prefer a secure Drive upload and a short README mapping files to CAIQ/SIG questions.

Regards,
Elena Martinez
Head of Security Ops — HealthCore
Attachment: none
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <security@healthcore.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG intake — need rotation ledger + assertion provenance

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the ledger + assertion samples and the SCIM delta. Quick notes on scope and delivery: 

- Rotation ledger: we will extract the rotation events for service accounts and key material (including KMS/HSM handoffs where applicable). Expect a CSV with columns: account_id, principal, rotated_by, rotation_time, rotation_reason, proof_link.
- SAML samples: we can export 10 assertion samples tied to the service account identities you specify. They will include raw assertion, audience, issue_instant, and signature metadata.
- SCIM delta: we'll provide a delta archive for Oct–Dec 2024 with role mappings; sensitive attributes will be redacted per our compliance redaction rules.

Plan: Marcus will assemble the artifacts and laura will review redactions. ETA: end of day Tuesday (2025-04-15) if that timeline works. We'll drop files to a secure Drive folder and share access.

Deliverables (tentative): rotation_ledger_2024-2025.csv, saml_assertion_samples.txt (10 samples), scim_delta_202412.zip, plus README mapping to CAIQ/SIG control ids.

Are there any particular accounts you want prioritized? If you can share a short list (3–5 service account emails or IDs), we'll attach assertion samples for those first.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — secure inference for production
Attachment: none
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG intake — need rotation ledger + assertion provenance

Naomi / Laura — attaching the artifact bundle for HealthCore. Summary of what's inside: 

- rotation_ledger_2024-2025.csv (generated from key management service logs and internal change records). Columns include account_id, principal, rotated_by, rotation_time (UTC), rotation_reason, proof_link. Redacted rotated_by for contractor accounts per our policy; mapping included in README.
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (10 samples). Each sample block contains: Assertion ID, Issuer, Subject, Conditions (NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter), Audience, Signature algorithm, raw XML. We replaced IP addresses with <redacted-ip> and removed any callback URLs.
- scim_delta_202412.zip (Oct–Dec 2024 deltas): includes role changes and timestamps; PII fields removed.
- README_healthcore_mapping.md (attached) — maps files to SIG control IDs and lists redaction decisions.

Attachment stubs: rotation_ledger_2024-2025.csv (CSV), saml_assertion_samples.txt (TXT), scim_delta_202412.zip (ZIP), README_healthcore_mapping.md (MD).

Notes: The ledger references a small set of HSM rotations which require an internal notarized proof link (internal only). For the CAIQ submission we'll surface summarized proof links; HealthCore can request the notarized logs under an NDA if needed.

—Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: rotation_ledger_2024-2025.csv; saml_assertion_samples.txt; scim_delta_202412.zip; README_healthcore_mapping.md
From: Elena Martinez <security@healthcore.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <procurement@healthcore.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG intake — need rotation ledger + assertion provenance

Naomi / Marcus — thank you, this looks good and aligns with what we need. A few quick follow-ups: 

- We will accept the summarized HSM proof links in the public CAIQ response; if we need the notarized logs we'll open an NDA request (good to know the path).
- Please prioritize assertion samples for service-account IDs: svc-ingest@redwood.com, svc-batcher@redwood.com.
- Can you add a single-line mapping in the README that ties each file to the exact SIG/CAIQ question ID? That will speed review on our side.

Tom — from procurement: we'll create JIRA ticket SEC-4127 to track intake.

If everything above is OK we'll mark the artifact set as accepted and proceed with CAIQ drafting.

Best,
Elena
Attachment: none
